target.title: fix(acp): close shared state database on gateway shutdown (#100637)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #100637: The standalone ACP gateway process (`serveAcpGateway`) opens a SQLite `DatabaseSync` connection through `createSqliteAcpEventLedger()` but never closes it on SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown. This leaks file descriptors and causes SQLite file locking issues during hot reload.

## Root Cause

`src/acp/server.ts` shutdown handler only calls `gateway.stop()` — it never calls `closeOpenClawStateDatabase()` to release the shared state DB handles. The `closeOpenClawStateDatabase()` function already exists in `src/state/openclaw-state-db.ts` but was not wired into the ACP shutdown path.

Note: the embedded Gateway shutdown sequence already calls `closeOpenClawStateDatabase()` indirectly through `closePluginStateDatabase()` (step 12 of `createGatewayCloseHandler`), but the standalone ACP process has its own shutdown path that bypasses the Gateway close handler.

## Changes

- `src/acp/server.ts`: import `closeOpenClawStateDatabase` and call it in `shutdown()` after `gateway.stop()`
- `src/acp/server.startup.test.ts`: add mock and test verifying `closeOpenClawStateDatabase` is called on shutdown

## Evidence

### Tests

```
$ pnpm test src/acp/server.startup.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  13 passed (13)

$ pnpm test src/acp/event-ledger.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  12 passed (12)

$ pnpm test src/state/openclaw-state-db.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  18 passed (18)
```
